summary: Master CSRD and ESRS reporting with practical tools for double materiality, disclosures, evidence packs, and assurance readiness. Book the training.
lede: CSRD training is for sustainability, ESG reporting, finance, internal audit and compliance professionals who work with disclosure data, controls or governance. It covers scoping reports, conducting double materiality assessments, mapping ESRS requirements to data owners, and building disclosure registers with data lineage and control checks to support sustainability statements and evidence preparation.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already work with ESG data, reporting, controls, or governance and now need to apply CSRD and ESRS requirements in a structured way. It is especially relevant if you prepare disclosures, validate source data, review controls, coordinate assurance, or brief leadership on sustainability reporting obligations. Sustainability Managers responsible for CSRD reporting scope and evidence. ESG Reporting Leads coordinating ESRS disclosures and stakeholder timelines. Finance Business Partners linking sustainability data with reporting controls. Internal Auditors reviewing disclosure traceability and control design. Compliance Officers tracking CSRD readiness and governance obligations. Corporate Governance Managers preparing board-level reporting packs. Environmental Data Analysts validating emissions and energy source data. Human Resources Reporting Specialists managing workforce disclosure inputs. Risk Analysts assessing sustainability risks and materiality outcomes. External Reporting Consultants supporting ESRS mapping and statement preparation.
prerequisites: No coding or programming is required. You will need a laptop, spreadsheet software, and access to sample or current sustainability data where possible. Familiarity with ESG reports, policy documents, and data extracts will help you get more value from the exercises, but the course provides the structures and templates needed to work through the CSRD and ESRS logic.
